caveats: Primary keep rates exclude baseline rejudge r03. Change classes overlap.
Bounded numbered-round spans omit subvariants; unaccepted elements are right-censored.
Plateau replays truncate an observed path and lose later kept rounds; they do not estimate causal cost savings.
Calibration uses three distinct owner-bound pairs; repeated votes are correlated. This does not establish historical judge-owner accuracy.

iterationsToAcceptance.reason: Artifact order is not iteration count. Complete element-level parent chains are required.

judgeOwnerAgreement.reason: No matched, same-scope binary judge/owner cohort established. Preferences and owner locks are different labels.

limitations: Image observations are not independent experiments.
Current, shipped, kept and owner-accepted are distinct.
Keep rates use only explicitly kept/rejected attempts, never unknowns.
Methods are a curated observational sample, not causal rankings.
File modification dates are inventory timestamps, not proven creation dates.
Scores from different judging contexts must not be joined into a progress curve.
